# Hardware & Building Materials Store - Tamil Nadu, India

> Physical retail store supplying hardware, electrical materials, plumbing supplies, construction materials, bathware, power tools, and water pumps.

## Business Profile
- Business Type: Hardware & Building Materials Retailer & Quotation Supplier
- Region: Tamil Nadu, India
- Primary Ordering Method: WhatsApp product enquiry and in-person store visits
- Secondary Ordering: Telephone enquiries and bulk quotation requests
- Currency: Indian Rupee (INR, ₹)
- Primary Languages: English, Tamil (தமிழ்)
- Location Verification: Verified Google Maps location link available on website

## Core Categories
- Electrical Materials: Cables, conduit pipes, modular switches, MCBs, distribution boards, lighting accessories.
- Hardware & Fasteners: Screws, bolts, nuts, anchor bolts, door handles, tower bolts, hinges, locks, drawer channels.
- Plumbing Materials: CPVC, UPVC, PVC pipes and fittings, ball valves, brass fittings, solvent cements.
- Construction Materials: Waterproofing chemicals, tile adhesives, cement additives, mesh, safety equipment.
- Bathware & Sanitaryware: Faucets, showers, bib taps, health faucets, angle valves, stainless steel sinks.
- Tools & Accessories: Power tools, drill bits, hand tools, cutting wheels, measuring tapes, toolkits.
- Pumps & Related Equipment: Submersible pumps, centrifugal monoblock pumps, pressure kits, float switches.

## Purchasing & Enquiry Process
1. Browse products or catalog categories.
2. Click "Enquire on WhatsApp" or "Request Bulk Quote" to submit required specifications or bill of quantities (BOQ).
3. The store responds with confirmed availability, genuine specifications, and customized quotation.
